Stereotype.name: BPMN
Stereotype.notes: A BPMN diagram is used for creating business process models using the BPMN notation.

Stereotype.name: BPEL
Stereotype.notes: A BPEL diagram is used for creating BPMN models from which BPEL can be generated.

Stereotype.name: BPMN1.1Core
Stereotype.notes: Graphical Flow Elements used on BPMN diagrams

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::BusinessProcess(UML::Activity)
Tag.description: A container for a single business process, including diagram.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::BPELProcess(UML::Activity)
Tag.description: A container for a single BPEL process, including diagram.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::Activity(UML::Activity)
Tag.description: Work that is performed within a business process.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::StartEvent
Tag.description: Indicates where a process will start.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::IntermediateEvent
Tag.description: An event that affects the flow of a process, but will not start or directly terminate it.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::EndEvent
Tag.description: Indicates where a process will end.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::Gateway(UML::Decision)
Tag.description: Controls the divergence and convergence of Sequence Flows.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::Pool(UML::ActivityPartition)
Tag.description: Represents a participant in a process.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::DataObject(UML::Artifact)
Tag.description: Provides information about what activities require to be performed and/or what they produce.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::Group(UML::Boundary)
Tag.description: A grouping of activities that does not affect the sequence flow.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::TextAnnotation(UML::Artifact)
Tag.description: A mechanism for providing additional information for the reader of a BPMN diagram.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::SequenceFlow(UML::ControlFlow)
Tag.description: Shows the order that activities will be performed in a process.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::MessageFlow(UML::ControlFlow)
Tag.description: Shows the flow of messages between two participants.

Tag.name: BPMN1.1::Association(UML::Dependency)
Tag.description: Used to associate information with flow objects.

Stereotype.name: BPMN1.1Types
Stereotype.notes: Supporting types used on BPMN diagrams
